current_100k_campaign.classification: valid full-protocol rerun for deterministic invocation counts and a documented loaded-host timing measurement; not an isolated single-worker benchmark

findings: All 150 successful 100k run rows were imported with byte-exact server hashes on 2026-10-20. All ten mean invocation counts round to the printed paper values.
The ten mean time-per-slot values differ from the paper. The imported rerun is reproducible evidence of its own loaded-host timing, not provenance for the old absolute values.

An untracked manuscript-adjacent intermediate dated 2026-09-12 has call counts within 0.107% of the paper values; its Milan times equal the paper values while its Random times are approximately half the paper values after rounding.
The manuscript intermediate is a lineage clue, not raw timing provenance: no source CSV, run rows, or documented transformation that generated it was found.
The paper absolute times are nearly constant topology-specific rescalings of the legacy 20k time-per-slot values for every complete five-rate row.
The near-constant ratios are evidence of a possible rescaling or a distinct benchmark, but they do not prove how the paper values were produced.
No scaling formula, 100k raw timing table, or generation script supporting the paper values was found in the available paper Git history or server project.

Both campaigns were configured for 75 concurrent panes on a 64-core host; actual concurrency declines as jobs finish. Their wall-clock values include workload interference and must be reported with that protocol.

release_acceptance_rule.invocation_counts: All 150 successful rows are imported; the ten recomputed means round to the paper values.
release_acceptance_rule.paper_value_provenance: The printed absolute-time values require archived run-level evidence that regenerates them; a rerun with different values cannot retroactively validate the existing table.
release_acceptance_rule.rerun_timing: The completed campaign is archived as a loaded-host measurement with up to 75 scheduler panes. Do not describe it as an isolated solver latency benchmark.
release_acceptance_rule.gate: Keep table6-paper-timing-disagrees-with-raw-results open until the paper is reconciled with the imported timing or the original supporting evidence is supplied.
